info.title: Winnow API
info.summary: Screening for systematic, scoping and rapid reviews.

get.description: The process is up and serving requests. Touches no dependencies.
The API can reach PostgreSQL and Redis. 503 names the dependency that failed.
What the sign-in pages should offer on this instance.
The token to send as X-CSRF-Token on every write. Keep it in memory only.

post.description: Single-user mode's first run: create the administrator and sign them in.

Sign in. With 2FA on, the first try answers 401 `totp_required`; send the same
request again with `totp` set to an authenticator or recovery code.
End this browser's session. Safe to call when already signed out.
Set a new password from an emailed link. Signs out every device.
Sign out everywhere, this browser included.
Change the password. Other devices are signed out; this one gets a new session id.

delete.description: Sign out one device. Only your own sessions can be found here.

post.description: A new secret for the authenticator app. Nothing changes until /2fa/enable.
Confirm with a code from the app. Returns recovery codes, shown only this once.
Replace all recovery codes. The old ones stop working.
Finish a Google sign-in on an account with two-factor authentication.

get.description: The reviews you are a member of, newest first.

post.description: Start a review. You become its owner; the standard exclusion reasons are added.

patch.description: Change the basics, status or settings. Send only what changes.

delete.description: Delete the review for everyone. Owner only.

post.description: Make another member the owner. You stay on as an admin.

A new review of your own with this one's settings, criteria, keywords, reasons and
labels. Nothing else is copied.

get.description:
Everyone in the review, in the order they joined. Emails only for those who manage
members.

patch.description: Change a member's role, stages or conflict-resolving. Never the owner's.

delete.description: Remove someone from the review. Their past work stays; the owner cannot be removed.

patch.description: Your own preferences in this review.

delete.description: Leave the review. The owner must transfer ownership first.

get.description: Invitations not yet accepted, newest first.

post.description: Invite someone by email. Inviting the same address again replaces the old link.

delete.description: Withdraw an invitation; its link stops working.

get.description: Inclusion criteria first, each list in its own order.

patch.description: Edit the text, move it between inclusion and exclusion, or reorder it.

get.description: Each group with its keywords.

delete.description: Deletes the group and its keywords.

post.description: Add terms to a group; ones it already has are skipped. Patterns are checked.

get.description: The reasons offered when excluding a record, in the order they are shown.

post.description:
Store a search export, or a whole set of them, and work out what each one is.

A search usually leaves a database in several files; they arrive together and each
becomes its own import, so PRISMA can count them and any one of them can be undone.
Nothing is imported until you confirm.

get.description: Every import in this review, newest first (guide 8.3).
The first records as Winnow reads them, and for CSV the column mapping to confirm.

post.description: Start the import. It runs in the worker; watch /events for progress.

delete.description: Undo an import: the batch and the records it brought in go.

get.description:
Server-sent events for this review: import progress today, more later (guide 10).

Only members reach this, and events carry counts, never record contents.
The records table: filtered, sorted and paged.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Words, "exact phrases", -exclusions, author:, journal:, keyword:, year:2018..2024, a DOI or a PubMed id (guide 8.9)
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Words, "exact phrases", -exclusions, author:, journal:, keyword:, year:2018..2024, a DOI or a PubMed id (guide 8.9)

get.description: How many records sit behind each filter.

post.description: Look for duplicates across everything imported so far (guide 9.1).

get.description: How many groups are waiting, and how many duplicates have been merged.
Groups of records that look like the same work, least certain first.

post.description: Keep one record of the group; the rest become its duplicates (never deleted).
"Not duplicates": these are different works, and Winnow stops asking.
Merge every group Winnow is sure about in one go (guide 8.4).

get.description:
The next records for me, to hold ahead of the one on screen (guide 8.5).

`exclude` lists the records the screen already holds, so they are not sent twice.
How far I am, and — only if I may know — how many conflicts are waiting.
One record as the screen shows it, whether or not I have decided about it.

put.description: Include, exclude or maybe; deciding again changes my decision.

get.description: My decisions, latest first.

put.description: Replace the labels I have put on this record.

post.description: A note on the record: private to me, or for the team.
How many records a bulk decision would settle, for the confirmation.
Decide every matching record at once (guide 8.5), logged with bulk=true.

get.description: Records whose reviewers disagree, with each decision side by side.

post.description: The final decision on one record.
Leave a team note and ask the record's reviewers to talk it over.

get.description: Whether a model exists for the stage, and what it has learnt from.

post.description: Retrain now rather than after the next 25 decisions (guide 8.10).

get.description: Includes found against records screened: mine, and the team's if I may see it.

Guide 8.5: how many records in a row I have excluded, and, once that reaches the
review's rule, an estimate of the relevant records still unscreened. Advice only.
My latest suggestion for this record, if I have asked. Sends nothing anywhere.

post.description: Ask the AI provider about this record now. Advice only: nothing is decided.

get.description: Every AI suggestion in the review, for reporting the use of AI in the methods.
How many records at full text have their PDF, are waiting, or cannot be found.
Every record at full text with its PDF, for finding the ones still missing.

post.description:
Attach a PDF to the record, replacing the one it had. It can be opened once the
virus scanner has cleared it, usually within seconds.

get.description: A link to the PDF that works for five minutes, for you only.

post.description: Ask Unpaywall (by DOI) and PubMed Central (by PMCID) for a free, legal copy.
Download one of the copies just found and attach it, as if it had been uploaded.

No full text could be found: the record leaves the full-text queue and is counted
in PRISMA's "reports not retrieved".

get.description: Highlights and comments on this PDF. Under blind mode, only your own.

post.description:
Upload a ZIP of PDFs. It is checked before anything is unpacked (a ZIP bomb, too
many files, or names that point outside the folder are refused), then each PDF is
matched to a record by the name of its file, for you to confirm.
Attach the PDFs to the records chosen for them; the rest are thrown away.

get.description: The PDF behind a link from `…/fulltext/url`, for whoever asked for the link.
The PRISMA 2020 flow, counted from the review (guide 9.4).

patch.description:
Records found outside the imported databases, and records removed before screening
for other reasons: what Winnow cannot count itself.

get.description: The diagram as SVG, PNG at 300 dpi or PDF.

parameters.name: inline

schema.description: Shown in the app rather than downloaded
schema.title: Inline

parameters.description: Shown in the app rather than downloaded

get.description:
Progress per reviewer and stage, time per record, decisions per day, and
inter-rater agreement (guide 8.15, 9.3).

How the review was screened, in words with its numbers, to edit and copy (guide
8.15). Agreement and how disagreements were settled appear only for members who may see
others' decisions.
The built-in tools, with their domains, signalling questions and judgements.
The studies included at full text, and where each one's assessment stands.
Per-domain counts and the traffic-light rows, from one final assessment per study.
The traffic-light table or the summary bar plot, as SVG or PNG at 300 dpi.
This study's assessments: mine, and others' unless blind mode hides them.

put.description:
Save my assessment of this study with one tool: a draft, or submitted when every
domain is judged.

post.description: Where several people assessed a study, the assessment the plots use.

get.description: Every version of every form, oldest first.

post.description: A new form, as a draft: nobody extracts with it until it is published.

delete.description: Only a draft; a published version keeps the data extracted with it.

post.description: Publish and lock this version; changing it later starts the next version.

get.description: The studies included at full text, and where each one's extraction stands.
This study's extraction: mine, and others' and the consensus unless blind.

put.description: Save my extraction of this study: a draft, or submitted when complete.

get.description: The submitted extractions side by side, where they differ, and the consensus.
Newest activity first, from reviews I still belong to.

put.description: A daily email of what is unread, off by default.

get.description: Other members screening in the last minute, and which stage; never which record.

put.description: Sent by a screening page every 30 seconds while it is open.

get.description: Everyone with an account, newest first, searchable by name or email.

post.description:
The account cannot sign in until enabled again, and its sessions end now. Its reviews
and work are untouched.

For someone who lost their authenticator and recovery codes: they sign in with their
password alone and set it up again. They are emailed.
End every session of the account, on every device.

get.description: The instance's settings; secrets are never shown, only whether they are set.

patch.description: Change the registration mode or the Unpaywall email while Winnow runs.

get.description: Queue, worker, disk, database and the last backup.

What happened in the review, newest first. `action` matches a whole action or a
family of them (`decision` matches `decision.made` and `decision.undone`).
The same log as a CSV file, with the same filters.

post.description:
Records (CSV, XLSX, RIS, BibTeX), filtered as in the records table, or the review's
full backup (owner only).
Restore a backup as a new review of yours; it is checked, then built in the worker.

get.description: What the invitation is for, before signing in. The address is shown masked.

post.description: Join the review. Your confirmed email must be the invited one.

Agreement.title: Agreement
Agreement.description: Guide 9.3. `None` means not calculable (no overlap, or one category only).

AuthOptions.title: AuthOptions
AuthOptions.description:
What this instance offers: shown on the sign-in pages, and used by project
settings to hide what the instance cannot do.

AutoResolve.title: AutoResolve
AutoResolve.description: Guide 8.4: merge everything at or above this score, plus the exact matches.

files.title: Files
files.description: Search exports, several at a time

databases.title: Databases
databases.description: One database per file, in the same order; overrides database_name

BulkDecisionIn.title: BulkDecisionIn
BulkDecisionIn.description:
Guide 8.5: an owner or admin decides many records at once, with confirmation.

`expected` is the count the person was shown; if the filter now matches a different
number, nothing is changed and the new count comes back.

ClusterMember.title: ClusterMember
ClusterMember.description: One record in a cluster, with everything the side-by-side comparison shows.

Curve.title: Curve
Curve.description:
Where each relevant record was found, in the order of screening: the recall curve
is a step up at each of these positions (guide 8.10).

DedupSummary.title: DedupSummary
DedupSummary.description: What the duplicates screen says before you open it.

FormPatch.title: FormPatch
FormPatch.description: Only a draft version can change; a published one is locked.

FulltextRecord.title: FulltextRecord
FulltextRecord.description: A record at full text and where its PDF stands; no one's decisions (guide 8.6).

FulltextSummary.title: FulltextSummary
FulltextSummary.description: The full-text stage at a glance: how many records have their PDF.

GoogleSignedIn.title: GoogleSignedIn
GoogleSignedIn.description: A Google sign-in finished with a second factor; `redirect` is where it started.

ImportPreview.title: ImportPreview
ImportPreview.description: What the upload found, before anything is written to the review.

ImportUpload.title: ImportUpload
ImportUpload.description:
The result of one upload: the batches it made, and anything it had to refuse.

One unreadable file among twenty does not lose the other nineteen.

KeywordsCreate.title: KeywordsCreate
KeywordsCreate.description: Add several terms to a group at once; terms it already has are skipped.

MaybeSuggestion.title: MaybeSuggestion
MaybeSuggestion.description: My latest suggestion for a record, if I have asked for one.

MethodsOut.title: MethodsOut
MethodsOut.description: Guide 8.15: a paragraph or two to edit and copy into the review's methods section.

OtherDecision.title: OtherDecision
OtherDecision.description: Someone else's decision: only ever sent to a caller who is allowed to see it.

PrismaManualIn.title: PrismaManualIn
PrismaManualIn.description:
What Winnow cannot count itself: records found outside the imported databases
(citation searching, websites, organisations) and records removed before screening
for other reasons (e.g. marked ineligible by an automation tool).

PrismaOut.title: PrismaOut
PrismaOut.description:
The flow, with where screening still has work to do: an unfinished stage makes
the diagram a snapshot, not the review's final numbers.

ProjectSettings.title: ProjectSettings
ProjectSettings.description: How screening runs. Stored as JSON; defaults fill keys added in later versions.

ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate
ProjectUpdate.description: Send only what changes. Optional text sent as "" or null is cleared.

QueuePage.title: QueuePage
QueuePage.description:
The next records for me. Fewer than asked for means the queue is empty after them;
how many are left overall is in the progress.

RecordExtraction.title: RecordExtraction
RecordExtraction.description: A study's extraction with one form version: mine, and others' unless blind.

RecordFiltersIn.title: RecordFiltersIn
RecordFiltersIn.description: The records table's filters: an export holds the records the table would show.

RecordFulltext.title: RecordFulltext
RecordFulltext.description: What there is for a record at full text: a PDF, or a note that none could be found.

RecordOut.title: RecordOut
RecordOut.description: A row in the records table; the detail view adds the rest.

RejectedFile.title: RejectedFile
RejectedFile.description: A file in a multi-file upload that Winnow could not take, and why.

ScreeningItem.title: ScreeningItem
ScreeningItem.description: One record as the screening screen shows it (guide 10's queue item).

SignedLink.title: SignedLink
SignedLink.description: A link to the PDF that works for five minutes, for the person who asked (guide 10).

Source.title: Source
Source.description: A setting's value and where it comes from: set here, or read from the environment.

StoppingAdvice.title: StoppingAdvice
StoppingAdvice.description: Guide 8.5: advice only. Winnow never stops anyone.

StudyRow.title: StudyRow
StudyRow.description: One row of the traffic-light table.

StudyStatus.title: StudyStatus
StudyStatus.description: One study included at full text, and where its assessment with a tool stands.
